query: select (select count(*) from public.media_map) as media_map_rows, (select count(*) from public.media_migration_queue) as media_queue_rows, (select count(*) from public.media_migration_queue where path like '%audio/%') as audio_path_queue_rows, (select count(*) from storage.objects where bucket_id='media' and name ~* '\.(wav|mp3)$') as media_audio_extension_rows, (select count(*) from storage.objects where bucket_id='media' and (name like 'audio/%' or name like '%/audio/%')) as exact_audio_prefix_objects
